name: RaceCategories
title: Race Categories
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
description:
The HL7 OID used in the US Core Implementation Guide value set in US Core version 7.0 and prior (https://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/STU7/ValueSet-omb-race-category.html
) has been retained, as the value set content remains identical. However, the preferred reference going forward is the version hosted by VSAC, which serves as the authoritative source for both US Core and C-CDA.
purpose: (Clinical Focus: This Grouping value set includes concepts representing race categories as defined by the U.S. Office of Management and Budget’s (OMB) 1997 Statistical Policy Directive No. 15 (SPD-15). The standard specifies five categories: American Indian or Alaska Native, Asian, Black or African American, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and White. It also includes concepts to indicate when race is unknown, not provided, or declined by the individual.),(Data Element Scope: Race category concept codes representing federally defined race categories, as well as codes indicating reasons why a race category was not collected, such as unknown, declined to answer, or not applicable.),(Inclusion Criteria: Concept codes from the CDC Race and Ethnicity (CDCREC) code system representing the five federally required race categories and Other Race, along with HL7 NullFlavor and Data Absent Reason codes to capture cases where race information is missing or not provided.),(Exclusion Criteria: Detailed race concepts as defined in CDCREC.)
